data.one_liner: Check if local app version matches Play Store or Apple Store and prompt updates.
data.what_it_does: Retrieves the version and store URL for the local app and compares it against the respective app store version. It provides built-in dialogs, bottom sheets, and pages to prompt users to update.
use_when: You need to enforce or suggest app updates from the Play Store and App Store.
You want pre-built UI components like alert dialogs or bottom sheets for updates.
avoid_when: You require advanced in-app update flows managed natively via Google Play In-App Updates API.
Your app is not hosted on public stores.
strengths: Supports both Android and iOS stores easily.
Provides built-in customizable UI options like dialogs, bottom sheets, and pages.
weaknesses: Relies on scraping or querying store pages via HTTP which might be fragile to store layout changes.
Requires manual version comparison handling setup.
data.setup_notes: Requires INTERNET permission on Android and NSAppTransportSecurity configuration on iOS.
